verdict.rationale: Checking an application's status is a fair question for a government e-services portal like e-FRRO, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that the root URL serves a script-only application shell and that the long-published entry path returns 404. Nothing documents a public status-lookup page or feature.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
